verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own docs say it connects to "your favorite tools in just a few clicks" and centralizes feedback through integrations. Its inbox spans chat channels like Slack and Discord, so the core idea exists but is described only generically. No specific support-desk or sales-tool integration is named, and webhooks are developer building blocks that earn no credit here. Missing for 10: named support-tool integrations (e.g. Zendesk/Intercom), sales/CRM integrations (e.g. Salesforce/HubSpot), docs showing feedback captured from those tools, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect feedback capture to support, sales, and chat tools I already use

citations.quote: Connect Featurebase with your favorite tools in just a few clicks, with new integrations added constantly.
Centralize insights to a single source of truth with a feedback portal, in-app widgets, and integrations.
Support customers wherever they are: In-app, Slack, Discord, Emails, and more from a single powerful inbox.
